values.components: K = 246 + 2,909; W = 1,145 + 13,384; M = 183 + 5,182 (officers + enlisted pairs as printed)
values.page: report No. 15 begins under the printed page number 193 in the OCR; the row carries the footnote 'For detailed statement, see pp. 168-173' (report No. 13). Confirm the exact page on the scan.
values.evidence: OCR line 26819 of warofrebellion271unit_djvu.txt (3,970,479 bytes): 'Gettysburg, Pa., July 1-4* || 246 || 2,909 || 1,145 || 13,384 || 183 || 5,182 || 23,049'; header 'No. 15. General Return of Casualties in the Union forces during the Gettysburg Campaign, June 3-August 1, 1863'. Arithmetic 246+2909+1145+13384+183+5182 = 23,049.

values.evidence: OCR lines 34730-34737 of warofrebellion272unit_djvu.txt (3,880,513 bytes) contain the numerals 2,592, 12,709, 5,150, 20,451 in a scrambled table block. 2,592 + 12,709 + 5,150 = 20,451. The assignment of 2,592/12,709/5,150 to killed/wounded/missing is inferred from magnitude and the printed total, not read from column headers: confirm on the scan. Regiment and brigade sums inside the return do not tally (the return's own caveat); adjudication is historian backlog H-01.

combined.note: Not a headline. Low end is only OR Union + OR Guild Confederate (23,049 + 20,451 = 43,500, computed here); Wikipedia states 'between 46,000 and 51,000'. The bare '51,000' on the site is Union 23,049 + Confederate 28,000 (an OR-versus-upper-estimate mix) and is a retired literal (rule F001).

artillery.note: The published gun totals (Wikipedia infobox: Union about 360, Confederate about 270) are well above the OOB's listed batteries (Union 55 batteries / 306 guns; Confederate 48 / 194). Derive gun totals only after the artillery OOB is completed from OR No. 9 (WP-DATA-07 step 4); until then label 'listed batteries'.
